name: Gemini 1.0 Ultra

released.note: In Gemini Advanced, under the name Ultra 1.0.

date.note: In the Gemini API it rolled out to select developers and partners; the Cloud blog page shows February 16, 2024.

summary.text: Gemini 1.0 Ultra is the biggest of the three sizes of Google's Gemini 1.0 models, which Google describes as natively multimodal, announced in December 2023. It reached consumers as Ultra 1.0 in Gemini Advanced, part of the Google One AI Premium plan, in February 2024, and developers and Cloud customers a week later through the Gemini API and, via an allowlist, Vertex AI.

inputModalities.note: The technical report describes interleaved text, image, audio and video input for the Gemini 1.0 family; it notes that Ultra had not yet been evaluated on audio.

contextWindowTokens.note: Stated for the Gemini 1.0 models as a family (trained with a sequence length of 32,768 tokens).

sources.locator: Access our most capable AI model with Gemini Advanced

access.note: Gemini Advanced (Google One AI Premium plan); Gemini API for select developers; Vertex AI via allowlist.

notes: Announced as Gemini Ultra, one of three sizes of Gemini 1.0; released as Ultra 1.0. At announcement Google said it would first give select customers, developers, partners and safety experts early access. The consumer offer was announced as Bard Advanced and launched as Gemini Advanced when Bard was renamed Gemini. Output modalities left out: the report says Gemini models can also produce images, which the launch posts do not describe. First Ultra model; no predecessor relation recorded.
